shots.focal_element: Amplitude logo mark (circle with waveform A) that resolves into the Amplitude wordmark with an ACADEMY sub-label
shots.transition_other: none - first shot of the video (anchors give no incoming transition)
shots.typography: Wordmark in a bold geometric sans, title case, tight tracking; 'ACADEMY' sub-label is a small bold all-caps sans with wide tracking, right-aligned under the wordmark.
shots.what_happens: On a white background a plain filled circle appears, the waveform 'A' draws inside it, then the wordmark slides/reveals out from behind the mark while the lockup recentres; the 'ACADEMY' label appears beneath at about 3.0 s, the lockup holds, then fades out near 5.0 s. Anchors place a chime SFX (x001) during the reveal. No voice-over in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale-pop a solid circle in the centre, draw the waveform glyph inside it with a stroke draw-on, mask-reveal the wordmark sliding right out from behind the circle as the group re-centres, fade in a small all-caps tracked 'ACADEMY' sub-label under the right edge, hold about 1.5 s, then fade the whole lockup to white.

shots.shot_type_other: multi-scene sequence joined by internal crossfades inside one detected shot: title card with 3D illustration (~6-8.5 s), kinetic definition card (~9-22 s), line-icon flow diagram (~22.5-41 s), then a screen recording of the Amplitude home dashboard (~41.5-51 s)
shots.composition_other: varies by scene: split (question text left, circular 3D illustration right) for the title card; left-aligned text block with a leader line for the definition card; horizontal left-to-right row of four icons for the flow diagram; full-bleed UI for the dashboard
shots.focal_element: In sequence: the question headline next to a 3D bar-chart illustration, the 'Onboarding' definition, the four-step 'AmpliTunes onboarding flow' icon row, and finally the Amplitude dashboard with a 'Create new' menu opening at the end
on_screen_text: At what step of my onboarding funnel are most users dropping off?
Guides a new user through their first experience with the product and leads them to finding value
shots.typography: Clean humanist/grotesk sans throughout (low-confidence guess: IBM Plex Sans), regular weight, sentence case, normal tracking. Question headline is medium-size dark text, left-aligned in three lines; 'Onboarding' is a larger brand-blue regular-weight term with smaller dark body text below; flow-diagram title is small sentence-case dark text top-left and step labels are small centred two-line captions under each icon. Dashboard UI text is too small to read at contact-sheet resolution.
shots.what_happens: After the logo fades, a title card fades in (small Amplitude Academy logo, the question 'At what step of my onboarding funnel are most users dropping off?' and a circular light-blue badge with a 3D staircase bar-chart illustration and a small chart icon) while the voice-over starts (w0). Around 8.5-9 s it crossfades to a definition card: a thin horizontal leader line from the left edge with a dot, the blue term 'Onboarding' and a two-line definition that mirrors the VO (w0-w25); it holds static through the friction / drop-off lines (w26-w45). At about 22.5 s it crossfades to the 'AmpliTunes onboarding flow' diagram, four outline icons (laptop with globe, person at laptop, plus-in-circle, music notes) linked by thin arrows, labelled with the funnel steps as the VO names them (w46-w99); the diagram is static. Near 41-41.5 s it crossfades into a screen recording of the Amplitude home dashboard (KPI cards, line charts, world map, event table) as the VO introduces funnel analysis (w100-w117); at about 51.0 s, on 'First, create a new funnel analysis chart' (w118-w124), a 'Create new' side menu opens with a dimmed backdrop. No cursor movement is legible in the frames.
shots.build_rebuild: Build four 1920x1080 scenes on a white background and chain them with ~0.5 s crossfades: a split title card (left-aligned question text, right circular 3D illustration), a left-aligned definition card with a leader line drawn in from the left edge, a static row of four line icons joined by arrows with centred captions, then a full-frame dashboard screen recording that ends with a left 'Create new' panel sliding in over a dimmed overlay.
